verdict.rationale: No documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out exists in the evidence. The pack only shows adjacent privacy measures: targeting attribute values such as user IDs and emails are never sent to GrowthBook and stay in SDK memory, inline server-side experiments make no third-party requests, and the platform can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting or env flag, documentation of what product telemetry self-hosted instances send, and independent corroboration.
